messages:
sarah.k: Heads up — planning to enable automatic KMS rotation (AWS + GCP) for prod vaults next month. Main concerns: envelope header/backwards compatibility, RBAC for the rewrap service, and audit traceability. Any immediate red flags?
chen: Quick note: rotating the underlying KEK id should not require changing envelope schema. Our current envelope is: `Envelope: { kek_id, alg, iv, ciphertext }`. If rotation only swaps kek_id -> new_kek but keeps schema stable clients should be fine.
alex_p: A few old services explicitly parse kek metadata and reject unknown kek_id patterns. We should inventory consumers that validate kek_id format before decrypt. I'll start a list.
jordan: Proposal for rollout: canary rewrap run against a tiny tenant set first. Canary steps = 1) provision new CMKs/keys with same aliases 2) run rewrap job on cache layer for canary tenants 3) watch decrypt error rate + consumer errors 4) promote gradually.
security-bot: FYI: past rotation (2024-08) introduced a 0.17% decrypt spike during canary because one service used an embedded key map. Recommend adding RBAC restrictions so only `rekey-operator` principal can call rewrap actions and avoid broad `kms:Admin` scopes.
chen: RBAC details: for AWS create a role `arn:aws:iam::acct:role/rekey-operator` with `kms:Decrypt`, `kms:Encrypt`, `kms:ReEncrypt*` limited to the two CMKs. GCP: bind `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to the service identity, and create a narrow custom role for rewrap. Also ensure service identities cannot list key metadata beyond what they need.
sarah.k: Audit logging: we need to emit `key_rotation.initiator`, `rewrap_job_id`, and `target_kek_id` in our app logs and correlate with CloudTrail / GCP audit logs. Cloud audit shows key usage but not the rewrap_job_id — include it as an indexed field in our internal audit pipeline.
alex_p: Manual fallback policy: if decrypt error rate > 0.1% for >5m after a batch, immediately pause rewrap for that batch, map traffic to previous KEK (fallback mapping), and open incident. Runbook snippet: 
```
- Pause rewrap job (control-plane): `POST /v1/rewraps/{job}/pause`
- Add fallback mapping: `kv/keys/alias_map: old->new (priority=old)`
- Notify #incidents and page infra-oncall
- Rollback step after signoff from sec/infra
```
jordan: Rewrap tool example for debugging: `./rekey-tool rewrap --from kek:old-123 --to kek:new-789 --object obj_42 --dry-run` we'll add `--verbose` to log kms request ids in the app audit record.
chen: Cross-cloud check: ensure Azure Key Vault metadata uses same envelope fields. If Azure uses `kid` vs `kek_id` naming, our decryptor should accept aliases. Add mapping layer in decryptor to normalize header keys.
alex_p: Vulnerability triage: found one service that logs full envelope metadata to stdout (including internal alias). Created ticket SEC-1422 and PR to redact envelope fields before logging. Prioritize before canary.
jordan: Timing suggestion: week 0 = preflight tests + RBAC PRs + mock rewraps. Week 1 canary (10% tenants, nightly rewrap windows 02:00-04:00 UTC), Week 2 ramp to 50%, Week 3 full roll. During weeks: RBAC freeze and extended alerting.
security-bot: Automation note: added `rotation-canary-job` to scheduler in dry-run mode. It will emit `rewrap_job_id` and `metrics: {decrypt_error_rate, latency_p95}` to the rotation dashboard.
sarah.k: Thanks all. I'll open the RBAC + audit-schema PR today and attach the test matrix. @chen please link SEC-1422 to the PR. @infra-oncall please confirm the nightly job slot and paging thresholds.
infra-oncall: Confirmed. Nightly window 02:00-04:00 UTC available. Paging thresholds set: decrypt_error_rate > 0.05% for 3m triggers page.
sarah.k: Perfect — next actions: PRs by EOD, run a dry-run canary next Tue, and hold a quick sync prior to running.
